claim_boundary: Diagnostic dev measurements only. Wilson intervals describe episode proportions; paired planners/scenarios sharing seeds are correlated, so these are not independent-seed ranking intervals. No release admission or trained-bicycle checkpoint claim.

creep_policy.duration_gate: none; a single .1s meaningful request moves <=.01m and the next stop immediately brakes

stuck_metric.command_rule: at least one nonzero issued command in the full window; raw v/omega before projection, or native action components when native
stuck_metric.count_rule: overlapping window ending steps, not unique seconds or yaw stalls
